plans.buy_case: DOW is flashing a textbook mean-reversion setup: RSI deep in oversold territory (28.5), Bollinger Band squeeze active, and a bullish RSI divergence suggesting momentum is turning despite lower price lows. The 50/200MA golden cross confirms uptrend structure, and price is holding above the 200MA—ideal confluence for a swing bounce. However, 'neutral' fundamentals and insufficient earnings/news data cap conviction—this is a pure technicals trade.
plans.entry_condition: Wait for RSI to touch 25 or lower (not yet hit), OR enter on a confirmed bounce off the lower Bollinger Band with volume expansion. Do not chase; be patient for a better entry given your small portfolio.
plans.exit_condition: Take profit at RSI 65–70 (overbought exit), or if price breaks below 34.00 with volume on a daily close (stop loss). Also exit if MACD histogram rolls over after an initial bounce—sign momentum is fading.
plans.risk: Fundamental weakness ('neutral' health) could trigger sudden bad news or earnings miss. No earnings date provided—you're blind to event risk. A 6-share position limits damage, but in a $3.2K portfolio, a 10% loss is material. Basic materials are cyclical; macro weakness (recession fears) could break this setup.

plans.buy_case: CTVA is flashing textbook mean-reversion signals: RSI deep in oversold (24.1), price touching lower Bollinger Band, and MACD turning up from the valley. The stock is anchored above its 200MA with a golden cross in place, suggesting the downtrend has structural support. A Bollinger Band squeeze into an oversold condition typically resolves with mean-reversion rallies of 3–8% in quality names.
plans.entry_condition: Enter on a touch or close below $77.50 (lower BB confirmation) with RSI still <28, OR wait for RSI to hit exactly 20–22 if price pulls back further. Do not chase—let the setup come to you.
plans.exit_condition: Exit 50% at RSI 55–60 (mean reversion exhaustion). Trail remaining 50% with a stop at RSI >70 or break below 50MA (81.08). Take full profits if price hits $84+ or if RSI reaches 75+ without follow-through volume.
plans.timeframe: 2–4 weeks. If no upside move within 3 weeks, reassess—the mean-reversion window closes.
plans.risk: Fundamental headwinds in agriculture/materials sector could override technicals; earnings miss or macro weakness in commodities could gap below 200MA. Position sizing (2 shares, $156) limits damage, but know that CTVA can be volatile on sector rotation.

plans.buy_case: WELL is firing a textbook mean-reversion setup: RSI deeply oversold (27.3), price kissing the lower Bollinger Band, and MACD turning up from the valley—all while the stock sits above its 200MA with a confirmed golden cross.
